Preserve side-view arena, 3/4-side characters, motion-ready hair, cape, clothing, weapons, shield, limbs, ears, wings, and horns with clear overlaps and pivots. Preserve the same boss face, horns, core silhouette, and identity across all phases. Remove every letter-like rune, written mark, numeral, plus sign, cross, arrow, chevron, banner marking, UI glyph, logo-like emblem, and writing-like symbol; use only unmarked material facets and non-linguistic circular light. Keep all subjects, poses, composition, palette, lighting, proportions, and effect placement consistent. No text, letters, numbers, writing-like glyphs, logos, watermarks, copyrighted franchise resemblance, artist imitation, photorealism, gore, horror, tiny high-frequency detail, unrelated magic palettes, or external asset collage.
